scripts.build: cross-env JEKYLL_ENV=production BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle BUNDLE_USER_HOME=.bundle BUNDLE_FORCE_RUBY_PLATFORM=true PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin:$PATH bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.serve: cross-env BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle BUNDLE_USER_HOME=.bundle BUNDLE_FORCE_RUBY_PLATFORM=true PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin:$PATH bundle exec jekyll serve -H 0.0.0.0
scripts.default: cross-env BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle BUNDLE_USER_HOME=.bundle BUNDLE_FORCE_RUBY_PLATFORM=true PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin:$PATH bundle exec jekyll serve -H 0.0.0.0 -t
